Title: Network Performance Monitor is Generally Available in Central India

Body.Content:
Azure Network Performance Monitor is now generally available in Central India region.

You can see the full list of available regions on the product web page.

Network Performance Monitor (NPM) is a suite of cloud-based networking solutions, designed to monitor the health of your network and the network connectivity to your applications.  The solution monitors connectivity between:

  • Cloud deployments and on-premises locations
  • Data centers and Azure regions that are connected by ExpressRoute
  • Multiple data centers and branch offices
  • Mission critical multi-tier applications/micro-services
  • User locations and web-based applications (HTTP/HTTPs)

Learn more about Network Performance Monitor and Network Watcher – our solutions for monitoring and troubleshooting networks in the cloud.
